Total Island Population: ~13,000 (permanent residents). Unlike other Tilean city-states that sprawl across mainland territories, Sartosa consists entirely of settlements on the island itself. The population is highly transient, swelling dramatically when pirate fleets return to port and shrinking when they depart for raiding. The island is dotted with small fishing villages, smuggler coves, and pirate havens, all following the anarchic "Pirate's Code" rather than traditional laws. King Giovanni Barbarossa rules nominally from the capital, but actual power rests with the various Pirate Lords who control different settlements and territories across the island.
